audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 is right: immobile artillery mage with one self-peel button vs a gap-closing assassin. WR 50.44% over 1146 games — slight but real edge, and the lane is decided by one cooldown.
Spikes accurate: 3-5 Satchel-bait all-ins, 6 hard-engage past his self-peel, first item one-rotation kill, late flank. All 4 entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Short Fuse (P) auto-reset burst tell was missing from the page, and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit. Chart is fully consistent (Qiyana 7/7 across full, content and packet) — no chart work needed.
audit.why: Ziggs W Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s — his only escape, the single cooldown the matchup runs on. His P empowered auto is the combo opener; its wind-up, not the ability cast, is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to cooldowns; P tell folded into breakdown.early.

audit.why: The 20s rank-1 Satchel window is the whole green-light system.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Terrashape (element swap) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge (W): 20s at rank 1, 12s max — his only escape, so he is catchable for that entire window after each use. It governs your forward steps. - W Terrashape spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Fight where the floor helps — brush Qs, ice roots, rock receipts. Open-ground Qiyana is a balance change away from honest.
edits.after: His burst opens with a Short Fuse empowered auto — the wind-up, not the cast, is your step-back cue. Farm through the chip and scale.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Ice-Q the moment he steps up to bomb the wave — the root holds him for the E follow, and his 20s Satchel is too slow to answer.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Each Terrashape is a plan — shield into the poke, camo for the approach. A panic swap leaves the all-in unloaded.
